reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to provide a content-creation workflow in DeepSeek Harness: briefing, script generation, image-text and video generation, then Douyin publishing. It is best classified as automation because it orchestrates multiple AI-assisted content-generation and external-publishing steps, with integration and MCP/API connectivity documented in the README.

summaries.zh: 该插件将 AiToEarn 的内容创作流程移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供创意提纲、脚本、图文与视频生成并支持抖音发布的自动化创作链路。
summaries.en: This plugin ports AiToEarn content creation into DeepSeek Harness as an automated workflow for creative briefing, script and media generation, and optional Douyin publishing.

capabilities: Connects to external AiToEarn services via MCP-compatible tools
Generates content outputs for scripts, image-text drafts, and video drafts
Automates end-to-end content workflow including briefing and publishing steps
Requires external authentication material via AITOEARN_API_KEY
Can invoke local tooling paths such as shell/file interactions through DeepSeek Harness utilities
Supports publishing flow that depends on external browser session state
Tracks generation status and credit/pricing via external API calls

reasons.code: README describes four skills (creative director, script writer, image-text publisher, video publisher) exposed as DSH plugin capabilities.
README states startup registers MCP tools `createImageTextDraft`, `createVideoDraft`, `getDraftTaskStatus`, `getMyCreditsBalance`, and `getDraftGenerationPricing` via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`.
README requires `AITOEARN_API_KEY` configuration and uses `agent-browser` session workflow for Douyin publishing.
Package metadata declares this as a DSH plugin bundle with patch manifest (`cordis.patch.yml`) and plugin entry fields.
